summaryZh: 这是已经公开发布的预览版，提供真实的 Windows EXE 和 macOS DMG。公开 macOS 副本已完成限定的暂停读变量检查、六项运行/测试/调试流程和正常退出检查；记录中的源码、原 SDK 均未改变。调试停止后出现过一条迟到通知警告，当前版本尚未修复；本地 SDK 选择、准备任务取消和完整 GoLand 功能仍未验收完成。

observations: Public release assets and producer provenance bind to the 492-file source identity above.
macOS public DMG was actually mounted read-only, copied, checked and later launched for the scoped native CFA workflow.
Current native CFA observation is scoped to one standard Pause, first Go caller locals and standard Stop without signals.
inferences: Windows zero-output go vet success is supported by an exact-source guarded command plus successful job/final producer report; no per-command log or exit JSON is invented.
limitations: Preview; complete GoLand feature parity remains open.
No local full EXE download/hash or manual Windows interactive editor acceptance claim; actual Windows installer build/install/start/uninstall has producer evidence.
macOS arm64 preview is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; debugging needs Apple Command Line Tools/Xcode debugserver.
The scoped CFA and six remaining native-case passes do not close every debugger Step/Continue/race/variant case.

Public .5 has an unresolved late stopped-notification warning after Stop; the observed target/test processes nevertheless terminated correctly. An assigned independent candidate fix is not a shipped .5 fix.
Two background-write10s wait warnings have unknown cause; retained modal-loop dumps do not prove Go-task I/O/lock ownership or explain SDK focus failure.
External SDK Add local native retry did not complete selection or register/save SDK. Preparation-task visible Cancel was not attempted; both remain open.
The README GIF remains a real .4 development-build capture on its recorded system, not a relabeled .5 recording.
No universal JetBrains-plugin compatibility claim: platform build ranges and required product APIs still apply.
Completed GUI profile system index/cache directories were deleted after normal quit; preserved source/log/config/UI/proof/installer artifacts retain their seals.
